The terminal_tool exception path returns raw traceback.format_exc() + raw str(e) (terminal_tool.py:3149-3161) — only the logger.error copy is redacted. _ENV_ASSIGN_RE misses *_KEY / *_PASS / *_PW (redact.py:136-139) — VERIFIED LIVE: FAL_KEY/OPENAI_KEY/MYSQL_PASS/DB_PW pass unmasked. Tokens split by \r / \n /ESC/zero-width chars escape every regex (redact.py:437-439, verified). The ACP adapter clears root handlers and installs a PLAIN logging.Formatter — zero redaction in that process (acp_adapter/entry.py:81-95, 236). Fix: redact process(list) + exception paths; extend the env-name regex; normalize control chars before matching; use RedactingFormatter in ACP.
